parsed.review_summary: The candidate edit correctly addresses both error targets: it removes the claim that the comment allows authors to pinpoint the relevant part, acknowledging instead that only a metric is named and the location can only be guessed; and it revises the conclusion from a fully grounded/specific judgment to one recognizing clear specification of the issue but only weak grounding. Unrelated reasoning is preserved, no numeric score or gold label is stated, and the rationale is coherent and self-contained.
